note: Small rustic campground in forest above the Rainy River: a few sites by the entrance and picnic area, the rest on a loop at the north end of the park. Site 2 sits up a steep bank from the river. Steep grades past the picnic area limit RV and large fifth-wheel travel (DNR). No ranger station; Big Bog State Recreation Area answers questions. --Claude
summary: DNR park data + map + ReserveMN catalog: 18 sites (15 back-in drive-in incl. 2 electric 30-amp, 3 walk-in), DNR 30-ft RV limit, vault toilets, hand pump; season 04-02..11-03 written; fees $20/$30 re-read (unchanged, fees note stripped of permit/booking boilerplate); riverview kept on site 2; DNR warns of steep grades past the picnic area (note caveat).
flags: ACCESS (agency raises a road issue): DNR seasonal update, 'rvs' field: 'Steep grades located after the picnic area limit RV and large 5th Wheel travel.' The same page posts an RV length limit of 30 feet, and ReserveMN offers every drive-in pad at 30-52 ft, so a 23-ft rig is within the posted limit: kept with a caveat in the note (warn, not drop). The 11 main-loop sites (8-18) are past the picnic area; sites 1E, 2, 5E, 6, 7 are not.

Waterfront: keep riverview. ReserveMN tags only Drive-In #2 'Water Front: Yes - Rainy River', 'Lake/River/Creek: .01 mile', 'Shaded: No', with the description 'site is up steep bank from the river' (pad 30 ft). On the DNR map site 2 is on the south shore just east of the rapids, about 190 m west of the boat launch (imagery ~48.6420,-94.0607, wooded shoreline strip). Every other drive-in site is tagged Partially/Fully shaded with no water tag; the main loop (8-18) lies under canopy about 50 m back from the east shore of the park's wooded point with a trail between. One site up a steep bank does not earn riverfront; it does support the view value.
